title: Driver Help: Uploading Photos for a Cleaning and Damage Fees Approval
content:
Applies to Cleaning and Damage Fees reports under review, at any fee level.

A report under review has an approval photo set: the number of photos it must have on file before its fee is approved. The photos still needed are uploaded by the driver who made the report, as one photo submission. Each upload is recorded on the report's evidence ledger as one photo submission at the fee level the report holds at the time, and the photos on file for the report rise by the photos in that upload.

## Photos still needed

The photos still needed for approval are counted only after the fee level held on the assessment is one whose entry gate lists the incident category reported.

Put the other way, while the level held on the assessment has an entry gate that does not list the incident category reported, the photos still needed for approval are not yet counted; they are counted once the level held is one whose entry gate lists that category.

## Hand-over card: `upload_report_photos_a5022c03`

**Capability.** The driver uploads one set of photos from the driver app to their own cleaning or damage report. The upload is recorded on the report's evidence ledger as one photo submission at the fee level the report currently holds, dated now, and the number of photos on file for the report rises by the photos in this upload. The driver sees the upload on the report and the new photo total.

**How it is invoked.** This is the driver's own tool. The agent unlocks `upload_report_photos_a5022c03` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the driver who made the report — runs it from the driver app.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the driver's report (the cleaning or damage fee assessment) the photos belong to, as given to the driver by support from the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `photos_in_upload` | the number of photos in this one upload | a whole integer count of photos, 1 or more, no decimals |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("photos_uploaded" once the upload is on file), `damage_event_id` (the reference number of the new photo submission entry), `damage_assessment_id` (the report reference number), `photos_in_upload` (the photos in this upload, an integer) and `photos_on_file` (the photos now on file for the report, an integer).

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A report has 2 photos on file and the driver uploads 3 in one submission: the receipt shows `photos_in_upload` 3 and `photos_on_file` 5, and the evidence ledger gains one photo submission entry.
